Measurements that are relevant on their own should be separate sensor entities. If a measurement isn't relevant on its own it should be an attribute.

The humidifier water level is relevant without knowing if the humidifier is running or not.

The brightness of a light isn't relevant without knowing if the light is on or off.

If an entity setting can be changed via a service, we expose the setting as an attribute of the entity.
There are plenty of sensor platform examples.
